Messages.Author: Matthew T. Morgan
Messages.Body:
If I have Monçada in my torpor region and Aaron Duggan in my ready region,
does it cost me a pool to have Aaron rescue Monçada from torpor?

Relevant card text:

Ambrosio Luis Monçada, Plenipotentiary [SW]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Lasombra
Group: 2
Capacity: 10
Discipline: aus for DOM OBT POT PRE
Sabbat Cardinal: Monçada cannot block. Actions directed at Monçada cost an
additional pool. If Monçada is ready during your discard phase, he can
untap another ready Lasombra.

This question came up in the jol tournament. A google search didn't turn
up anything. My suspicion is that Monçada's card text doesn't actually
care about (D) actions. Aaron is still targetting Monçada, even though
the action is undirected.

Thanks in advance!

-Matt

--

Zopf's correct. Card text is referring to directed actions. Undirected actions
are not directed. For it to work the other way, it would've had to read
"Actions targeting Monçada cast an additional pool."
